description: This file implements server-side logic for a user profile page within a SvelteKit app, migrating from Prisma to Django REST API. It contains functions to load user profile data and handle profile updates, including validation and API interactions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches and prepares user profile data from the Django REST API, handles redirection if user is not authenticated.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Handles profile update form submission, performs validation, formats data, and sends PATCH request to Django API.

calls: apiRequest('/profile/', { method: 'PATCH', body: djangoData }, { cookies, org })
